evidence: Swap test fails: a GP surgery appointment booker or a council library room booker could take the frame unchanged (masthead with council name in bold body text and a stock bin outline icon, '1. When 2. ... 3. ...' text stepper, outlined day buttons, time-tile grid, white bordered info card, green filled 'Next', error-summary box). Only the copy (Quarry Road, DRC- permit, DR-204117, 'Few left'/'Full') is bound to this product.

Category-guess test fails: the predicted default for a UK council booking service is a pale grey ground, one civic green, bold system-like sans, numbered steps, a summary list with 'Change' links and a red-bordered 'There is a problem' box; every one of these is on screen (root/default/1280-light, confirm/errors/1280-dark).

Similar-prompt test fails: 'booking for a council bulky-waste collection or a swimming-pool session' would very likely land on the same green-on-pale form, time tiles with availability tags and plain reference card.

What is bound to the product is content and voice, not the identity layer: the 20-minute slot grid with 'Few left'/'Full' tags, 'Starts DRC-, then five digits', 'Show this at the gate, on your phone or on paper'. On Operate surfaces the conventional structure is correct and is not counted against it; but the reference card on /done, the one place a signature could live (the thing shown at the gate), is set as a plain card heading.

unfinished: Identity is only 'Dunmore District Council' in bold body text beside a stock bin outline icon; nothing else carries the centre or the council (root/default/375-light top).

No focal point on the when page beyond a field of identical outlined tiles; at 1280 the slot grid stops at about x=816 while the 'Opening days' card runs to x=1184, so the column stops short for no reason (root/default/1280-light, root/date-chosen/1280-light).
Done page at 1440: a full-width reference card above a half-width 'At the centre' card, then the footer ends at y~716 with an empty grey band below (done/default/1440-light).
Done page reference DR-204117 is only a slightly larger bold heading inside a plain card; the one thing residents must show at the gate gets no treatment of its own.
Vehicle page at 375: the info (i) button is stranded alone on its own line under the segmented control (vehicle/van/375-light).
'Back to the slots' link sits tight against the H1 with no gap (vehicle/default/1280-light y~113-145).
Headings differ from body mainly in size and weight of the same face; sections such as 'Opening days' and 'At the centre' are only a heading and a paragraph in a bordered box.
